list.name: ds_dw
list.label: SCOM Data Warehouse
list.description: Microsoft SQL Server data source for the OperationsManagerDW database. Chosen automatically if its name contains "Warehouse" or "DW"; otherwise pick it here.

list.definition:
WITH tree AS (
  SELECT t.ManagedEntityTypeRowId, CAST(CASE t.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName WHEN 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.DistributedApplication' THEN 'Distributed application' ELSE 'Group' END AS nvarchar(30)) AS Kind
  FROM dbo.vManagedEntityType t
  WHERE t.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName IN ('Microsoft.SystemCenter.InstanceGroup', 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.DistributedApplication')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT v.ManagedEntityTypeRowId, tree.Kind
  FROM dbo.vManagedEntityTypeManagementPackVersion v
  JOIN tree ON v.BaseManagedEntityTypeRowId = tree.ManagedEntityTypeRowId
),
found AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.DisplayName AS n
  FROM tree
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType t ON t.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = tree.ManagedEntityTypeRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagementPack mp ON mp.ManagementPackRowId = t.ManagementPackRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = t.ManagedEntityTypeRowId
  WHERE '${stackscope}' = 'All groups and applications' OR mp.SealedInd = 0
)
SELECT n AS __text, n AS __value FROM found
UNION ALL
SELECT '(no stacks found)', '(no stacks found)' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM found)
ORDER BY 1

title: Availability - Monthly Report

panels.description: Availability per calendar month for each selected stack. The dashed line is the SLA target. The first and last month are cut at the ends of the time range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH tree AS (
  SELECT t.ManagedEntityTypeRowId, CAST(CASE t.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName WHEN 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.DistributedApplication' THEN 'Distributed application' ELSE 'Group' END AS nvarchar(30)) AS Kind
  FROM dbo.vManagedEntityType t
  WHERE t.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName IN ('Microsoft.SystemCenter.InstanceGroup', 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.DistributedApplication')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT v.ManagedEntityTypeRowId, tree.Kind
  FROM dbo.vManagedEntityTypeManagementPackVersion v
  JOIN tree ON v.BaseManagedEntityTypeRowId = tree.ManagedEntityTypeRowId
),
stk AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.ManagedEntityRowId, e.DisplayName, tree.Kind
  FROM tree
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType t ON t.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = tree.ManagedEntityTypeRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = t.ManagedEntityTypeRowId
  WHERE e.DisplayName IN (${stack:singlequote})
),
rel AS (
  SELECT r.SourceManagedEntityRowId AS src, r.TargetManagedEntityRowId AS tgt
  FROM dbo.vRelationship r
  JOIN dbo.vRelationshipManagementGroup rg ON rg.RelationshipRowId = r.RelationshipRowId AND rg.ToDateTime IS NULL
  JOIN dbo.vRelationshipType rt ON rt.RelationshipTypeRowId = r.RelationshipTypeRowId
       AND rt.RelationshipTypeSystemName IN ('Microsoft.SystemCenter.InstanceGroupContainsEntities', 'System.Containment')
),
walk AS (
  SELECT s.ManagedEntityRowId AS StackId, rel.tgt AS MemberId, 1 AS lvl
  FROM stk s JOIN rel ON rel.src = s.ManagedEntityRowId
  UNION ALL
  SELECT w.StackId, rel.tgt, w.lvl + 1
  FROM walk w JOIN rel ON rel.src = w.MemberId
  WHERE w.lvl < 4
),
mm AS (
  SELECT w.StackId, e.ManagedEntityRowId AS MemberId, e.DisplayName AS Member, ty.ManagedEntityTypeDefaultName AS TypeName,
         e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId AS HostId, em.ManagedEntityMonitorRowId, MIN(em.DWCreatedDateTime) AS Seen
  FROM walk w
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = w.MemberId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType ty ON ty.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityMonitor em ON em.ManagedEntityRowId = e.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vMonitor mo ON mo.MonitorRowId = em.MonitorRowId AND mo.MonitorSystemName = 'System.Health.AvailabilityState'
  WHERE e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId NOT IN (SELECT ManagedEntityTypeRowId FROM tree)
  GROUP BY w.StackId, e.ManagedEntityRowId, e.DisplayName, ty.ManagedEntityTypeDefaultName, e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId, em.ManagedEntityMonitorRowId
),
sn AS (
  SELECT StackId, COUNT(DISTINCT MemberId) AS n FROM mm GROUP BY StackId
)
,
mh AS (
  SELECT mm.StackId, mm.MemberId, h.DateTime,
         CAST(h.InRedStateMilliseconds AS bigint) AS red, CAST(h.HealthServiceUnavailableMilliseconds AS bigint) AS hsu,
         CAST(h.InRedStateMilliseconds AS bigint) + h.HealthServiceUnavailableMilliseconds AS bad,
         CAST(h.InYellowStateMilliseconds AS bigint) AS warn,
         CAST(h.InPlannedMaintenanceMilliseconds AS bigint) AS pl,
         CAST(h.InDisabledStateMilliseconds AS bigint) AS dis
  FROM mm
  JOIN State.vStateHourly h ON h.ManagedEntityMonitorRowId = mm.ManagedEntityMonitorRowId
  WHERE h.DateTime BETWEEN DATEADD(hour, -1, $__timeFrom()) AND $__timeTo()
),
sh AS (
  SELECT s.ManagedEntityRowId AS StackId, s.DisplayName, s.Kind, mh.DateTime,
         CASE WHEN ('${rule}' = 'All components down') THEN CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = sn.n THEN MIN(mh.bad + CASE WHEN ('${maint}' = 'Count planned maintenance as downtime') THEN mh.pl ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END
              ELSE MAX(mh.bad + CASE WHEN ('${maint}' = 'Count planned maintenance as downtime') THEN mh.pl ELSE 0 END) END AS bad,
         CASE WHEN ('${rule}' = 'All components down') THEN CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = sn.n THEN MIN(mh.warn) ELSE 0 END ELSE MAX(mh.warn) END AS warn,
         CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = sn.n THEN MIN(mh.pl) ELSE 0 END AS plmin,
         CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = sn.n THEN MIN(mh.dis) ELSE 0 END AS dismin
  FROM mh
  JOIN stk s ON s.ManagedEntityRowId = mh.StackId
  JOIN sn ON sn.StackId = mh.StackId
  GROUP BY s.ManagedEntityRowId, s.DisplayName, s.Kind, mh.DateTime, sn.n
),
sx AS (
  SELECT StackId, DisplayName, Kind, DateTime,
         CASE WHEN bad > 3600000 THEN CAST(3600000 AS bigint) ELSE bad END AS bad,
         warn,
         CASE WHEN ('${maint}' = 'Count planned maintenance as downtime') THEN 0 ELSE plmin END + dismin AS excl
  FROM sh
  WHERE DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
)
,
win AS (
  SELECT s.ManagedEntityRowId AS StackId, s.DisplayName, s.Kind,
         CASE WHEN MIN(m.Seen) > CAST($__timeFrom() AS datetime2) THEN CAST(MIN(m.Seen) AS datetime2) ELSE CAST($__timeFrom() AS datetime2) END AS A,
         CASE WHEN CAST($__timeTo() AS datetime2) < GETUTCDATE() THEN CAST($__timeTo() AS datetime2) ELSE CAST(GETUTCDATE() AS datetime2) END AS B
  FROM stk s JOIN mm m ON m.StackId = s.ManagedEntityRowId
  GROUP BY s.ManagedEntityRowId, s.DisplayName, s.Kind
),
dd AS (
  SELECT w.StackId, w.DisplayName, w.Kind, d.D,
         CASE WHEN CAST(DATEDIFF(second, CASE WHEN d.D > w.A THEN d.D ELSE w.A END, CASE WHEN DATEADD(day, 1, d.D) < w.B THEN DATEADD(day, 1, d.D) ELSE w.B END) AS bigint) * 1000 - COALESCE(h.excl, 0) > 0
              THEN CAST(DATEDIFF(second, CASE WHEN d.D > w.A THEN d.D ELSE w.A END, CASE WHEN DATEADD(day, 1, d.D) < w.B THEN DATEADD(day, 1, d.D) ELSE w.B END) AS bigint) * 1000 - COALESCE(h.excl, 0) ELSE 0 END AS total,
         COALESCE(h.bad, 0) AS bad, COALESCE(h.warn, 0) AS warn
  FROM win w
  CROSS APPLY (SELECT DATEADD(day, n.number, CAST(CAST(w.A AS date) AS datetime2)) AS D FROM master.dbo.spt_values n WHERE n.type = 'P' AND n.number <= DATEDIFF(day, w.A, w.B)) d
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT x.StackId, CAST(x.DateTime AS date) AS Dy, SUM(x.bad) AS bad, SUM(x.warn) AS warn, SUM(x.excl) AS excl FROM sx x GROUP BY x.StackId, CAST(x.DateTime AS date)) h
         ON h.StackId = w.StackId AND h.Dy = CAST(d.D AS date)
),
mth AS (
  SELECT CAST(DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(d.D), MONTH(d.D), 1) AS datetime) AS time, d.DisplayName, SUM(d.bad) AS bad, SUM(d.total) AS total FROM dd d
  GROUP BY DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(d.D), MONTH(d.D), 1), d.DisplayName
)
SELECT y.time, y.metric, y.value FROM (
  SELECT m.time, m.DisplayName AS metric, ROUND(100.0 * (1.0 - CAST(m.bad AS float) / m.total), 3) AS value FROM mth m WHERE m.total > 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT m.time, 'SLA target %', COALESCE(TRY_CAST('${sla}' AS float), 99.9) FROM mth m WHERE m.total > 0
) y
ORDER BY y.time

),

  GROUP BY DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(d.D), MONTH(d.D), 1), d.DisplayName
)
SELECT FORMAT(m.Mth, 'yyyy-MM') AS Month, m.DisplayName AS Stack,
       CASE WHEN m.total > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * (1.0 - CAST(m.bad AS float) / m.total), 3) END AS "Availability %",
       ROUND(m.bad / 60000.0, 1) AS "Downtime (min)",
       CASE WHEN m.total > 0 AND 100.0 * (1.0 - CAST(m.bad AS float) / m.total) >= COALESCE(TRY_CAST('${sla}' AS float), 99.9) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "Meets SLA"
FROM mth m
WHERE m.total > 0
ORDER BY m.Mth DESC, m.DisplayName

       AND rt.RelationshipTypeSystemName IN ('Microsoft.SystemCenter.InstanceGroupContainsEntities', 'System.Containment')
),
walk AS (
  SELECT s.ManagedEntityRowId AS StackId, rel.tgt AS MemberId, 1 AS lvl
  FROM stk s JOIN rel ON rel.src = s.ManagedEntityRowId
  UNION ALL
  SELECT w.StackId, rel.tgt, w.lvl + 1
  FROM walk w JOIN rel ON rel.src = w.MemberId
  WHERE w.lvl < 4
),
mm AS (
  SELECT w.StackId, e.ManagedEntityRowId AS MemberId, e.DisplayName AS Member, ty.ManagedEntityTypeDefaultName AS TypeName,
         e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId AS HostId, em.ManagedEntityMonitorRowId, MIN(em.DWCreatedDateTime) AS Seen
  FROM walk w
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = w.MemberId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType ty ON ty.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityMonitor em ON em.ManagedEntityRowId = e.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vMonitor mo ON mo.MonitorRowId = em.MonitorRowId AND mo.MonitorSystemName = 'System.Health.AvailabilityState'
  WHERE e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId NOT IN (SELECT ManagedEntityTypeRowId FROM tree)
  GROUP BY w.StackId, e.ManagedEntityRowId, e.DisplayName, ty.ManagedEntityTypeDefaultName, e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId, em.ManagedEntityMonitorRowId
),
sn AS (
  SELECT StackId, COUNT(DISTINCT MemberId) AS n FROM mm GROUP BY StackId
)
,
mh AS (
  SELECT mm.StackId, mm.MemberId, h.DateTime,
         CAST(h.InRedStateMilliseconds AS bigint) AS red, CAST(h.HealthServiceUnavailableMilliseconds AS bigint) AS hsu,
         CAST(h.InRedStateMilliseconds AS bigint) + h.HealthServiceUnavailableMilliseconds AS bad,
         CAST(h.InYellowStateMilliseconds AS bigint) AS warn,
         CAST(h.InPlannedMaintenanceMilliseconds AS bigint) AS pl,
         CAST(h.InDisabledStateMilliseconds AS bigint) AS dis
  FROM mm
  JOIN State.vStateHourly h ON h.ManagedEntityMonitorRowId = mm.ManagedEntityMonitorRowId
  WHERE h.DateTime BETWEEN DATEADD(hour, -1, $__timeFrom()) AND $__timeTo()
),
sh AS (
  SELECT s.ManagedEntityRowId AS StackId, s.DisplayName, s.Kind, mh.DateTime,
         CASE WHEN ('${rule}' = 'All components down') THEN CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = sn.n THEN MIN(mh.bad + CASE WHEN ('${maint}' = 'Count planned maintenance as downtime') THEN mh.pl ELSE 0 END) ELSE 0 END
              ELSE MAX(mh.bad + CASE WHEN ('${maint}' = 'Count planned maintenance as downtime') THEN mh.pl ELSE 0 END) END AS bad,
         CASE WHEN ('${rule}' = 'All components down') THEN CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = sn.n THEN MIN(mh.warn) ELSE 0 END ELSE MAX(mh.warn) END AS warn,
         CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = sn.n THEN MIN(mh.pl) ELSE 0 END AS plmin,
         CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = sn.n THEN MIN(mh.dis) ELSE 0 END AS dismin
  FROM mh
  JOIN stk s ON s.ManagedEntityRowId = mh.StackId
  JOIN sn ON sn.StackId = mh.StackId
  GROUP BY s.ManagedEntityRowId, s.DisplayName, s.Kind, mh.DateTime, sn.n
),
sx AS (
  SELECT StackId, DisplayName, Kind, DateTime,
         CASE WHEN bad > 3600000 THEN CAST(3600000 AS bigint) ELSE bad END AS bad,
         warn,
         CASE WHEN ('${maint}' = 'Count planned maintenance as downtime') THEN 0 ELSE plmin END + dismin AS excl
  FROM sh
  WHERE DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
)
,
win AS (
  SELECT s.ManagedEntityRowId AS StackId, s.DisplayName, s.Kind,
         CASE WHEN MIN(m.Seen) > CAST($__timeFrom() AS datetime2) THEN CAST(MIN(m.Seen) AS datetime2) ELSE CAST($__timeFrom() AS datetime2) END AS A,
         CASE WHEN CAST($__timeTo() AS datetime2) < GETUTCDATE() THEN CAST($__timeTo() AS datetime2) ELSE CAST(GETUTCDATE() AS datetime2) END AS B
  FROM stk s JOIN mm m ON m.StackId = s.ManagedEntityRowId
  GROUP BY s.ManagedEntityRowId, s.DisplayName, s.Kind
),
dd AS (
  SELECT w.StackId, w.DisplayName, w.Kind, d.D,
         CASE WHEN CAST(DATEDIFF(second, CASE WHEN d.D > w.A THEN d.D ELSE w.A END, CASE WHEN DATEADD(day, 1, d.D) < w.B THEN DATEADD(day, 1, d.D) ELSE w.B END) AS bigint) * 1000 - COALESCE(h.excl, 0) > 0
              THEN CAST(DATEDIFF(second, CASE WHEN d.D > w.A THEN d.D ELSE w.A END, CASE WHEN DATEADD(day, 1, d.D) < w.B THEN DATEADD(day, 1, d.D) ELSE w.B END) AS bigint) * 1000 - COALESCE(h.excl, 0) ELSE 0 END AS total,
         COALESCE(h.bad, 0) AS bad, COALESCE(h.warn, 0) AS warn
  FROM win w
  CROSS APPLY (SELECT DATEADD(day, n.number, CAST(CAST(w.A AS date) AS datetime2)) AS D FROM master.dbo.spt_values n WHERE n.type = 'P' AND n.number <= DATEDIFF(day, w.A, w.B)) d
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT x.StackId, CAST(x.DateTime AS date) AS Dy, SUM(x.bad) AS bad, SUM(x.warn) AS warn, SUM(x.excl) AS excl FROM sx x GROUP BY x.StackId, CAST(x.DateTime AS date)) h
         ON h.StackId = w.StackId AND h.Dy = CAST(d.D AS date)
)
SELECT TOP 30 CONVERT(varchar(10), d.D, 23) AS Day, d.DisplayName AS Stack,
       ROUND(d.bad / 60000.0, 1) AS "Downtime (min)",
       ROUND(100.0 * (1.0 - CAST(d.bad AS float) / d.total), 3) AS "Availability %"
FROM dd d
WHERE d.bad > 0 AND d.total > 0
ORDER BY d.bad DESC
